findings.issue: loadForbiddenPatterns uses raw JSON.parse despite importing safeJsonParse — violates security-patterns.md §2 (the rule the standards-checker itself enforces). ENFORCEMENT_GAP.
findings.recommendation: Replace JSON.parse(raw) with safeJsonParse(filePath, []). Validate result is array.
findings.evidenceNote: Read line 768; confirmed safeJsonParse already imported at line 22.

findings.issue: forbidden-patterns rule pack does not exist on disk and no installer scaffolding ships. Commit message advertises `.workflow/standards/forbidden-patterns.json`; loader reads `.workflow/state/forbidden-patterns.json`. Neither path nor parent dir exists. Feature is silent no-op.
findings.recommendation: Ship `.workflow/state/forbidden-patterns.json.template` + add to lib/installer.js. Reconcile commit-message path with code. Add stderr warning when loader returns [] but state/ dir exists.

findings.issue: ReDoS — checkForbiddenPatterns compiles arbitrary regex from JSON config, no timeout, no input cap. `^(a+)+$` × 26 chars empirically takes 3.3s.
findings.recommendation: Add ReDoS pre-compile linter (reject nested quantifiers), 200ms wall-clock budget per file, content.length cap.

findings.issue: requiresArchitect bypasses gate when taskMeta.level is missing/empty. No fail-closed for stories without level field.
findings.recommendation: Treat missing level as L1 when type='story'/'epic'. Fail-closed.

findings.issue: globMatch ** edge cases: `dir/**` does NOT match `dir`; `**/foo` matches `xfoo` (no directory boundary).
findings.recommendation: Add explicit cases for dir/** matching dir; `**/foo` requires path separator.
findings.evidenceNote: Manual regex tracing of globMatch implementation lines 723-757.

findings.issue: globMatch is the 3rd implementation of glob-to-regex (also in flow-feature-dossier.js:257, flow-logic-rules.js:136).
Cross-direction dependency: scripts/flow-architect-pass.js requires from scripts/hooks/core/. Inverts established convention (hooks/core depends on scripts/, not vice versa).
findings.recommendation: Move writeArchitectRunMarker to scripts/flow-architect-runs.js (neutral location); both gate and architect-pass require from there.
findings.evidenceNote: No other script-to-hooks-core require exists in scripts/flow-*.js (verified).

findings.issue: Architect-runs markers never garbage-collected. Stale markers from completed tasks accumulate; task-ID collision bypasses gate.
findings.recommendation: Add GC on session-end (configurable retention) or include createdAt + age check in hasArchitectRun.
findings.evidenceNote: Adversary NEW-2; no cleanup logic in module.

findings.issue: hasArchitectRun checks fs.existsSync only — empty/zero-byte file with right name bypasses gate.
findings.recommendation: Validate JSON parse + taskId field match.

findings.issue: TodoWrite is in mutation-block set. Blocks planning before architect run; chicken-and-egg if agent uses todos to track architect-pass progress.
findings.recommendation: Reconsider including TodoWrite in the gate — Edit/Write/Bash are sufficient.
findings.evidenceNote: Adversary NEW-1; gate fires on toolName === 'TodoWrite'.

findings.issue: Path traversal: taskId not validated against /^wf-[a-f0-9]{8}$/i before path.join. Realistic exploit requires already-compromised state file.
findings.recommendation: Import validateTaskId from flow-utils; reject in getArchitectRunPath.
findings.evidenceNote: Code-read confirms only typeof check. Adversary downgraded from MED to LOW.

findings.issue: loadForbiddenPatterns silently swallows JSON syntax errors. Malformed JSON → returns [] silently.
findings.recommendation: Stderr warn or push synthetic violation when parse fails.

findings.issue: Inline 30-line phase+taskMeta resolution duplicates logic that should be a shared helper.
findings.recommendation: Extract resolveCurrentTaskContext() — gate becomes a 3-line dispatch.

findings.issue: writeArchitectRunMarker leaks tmp files on rename failure (tmp-${pid}).
findings.recommendation: Add fs.unlinkSync(tmpPath) in catch (wrapped in own try/catch).

findings.issue: Marker write happens unconditionally on PASS even when IGR disabled. Stale markers if config flips back later.
findings.recommendation: Guard with isGateEnabled check OR include specHash in marker for staleness detection.
findings.evidenceNote: Code-read inference; not observed in incident.

findings.issue: Speculative exports never consumed externally (getArchitectRunPath, requiresArchitect, isGateEnabled, ARCHITECT_RUNS_DIR).
findings.recommendation: Drop unused exports or keep only test-exercised ones.
findings.evidenceNote: pre-tool-deps.js only imports checkArchitectRequired; flow-architect-pass.js only imports writeArchitectRunMarker.

findings.issue: Path discrepancy: commit message says .workflow/standards/forbidden-patterns.json; code reads .workflow/state/forbidden-patterns.json.
findings.recommendation: Pick one; update either commit message or code/docstring. (Subset of H2.)
